specs.Item Highlight: Dual WiFi 2.4/5 GHz, H3 Processor, 4K Android Mini PC Box

features: Advanced System with Enhanced Memory: 2GB RAM and 16GB ROM with Quad-Core processor and built-in WiFi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac. Supports 3D, 4K resolution at 60Hz, and H.265 video decoding. The 64-bit CPU ensures fast and stable operation, preventing crashes caused by insufficient memory

High-Performance Hardware Configuration: Features 2GB RAM and 16GB eMMC storage with 64-bit CPU architecture that supports fast processing and stable system operation for smooth streaming and app performance

Dual-Band WiFi Connectivity: Supports both 2.4GHz and 5GHz WiFi bands for flexible wireless connectivity options, allowing you to choose the best frequency for your network environment and streaming needs
Compatibility Notice: This device is not suitable for CCTV camera applications. Designed specifically for media streaming and entertainment purposes

Modern Android System with H3 Processor: Runs on Android operating system with H3 chip technology, offering strong performance and access to a wide range of Android applications. The system features modern material design with updated UI elements and boots up quickly with 20% improved overall performance

Multiple Connectivity Options: Equipped with 4 USB 2.0 ports, HDMI 2.0 output supporting up to 4K resolution, RJ45 Ethernet port, SD card slot, and SPDIF audio output for comprehensive device connectivity and media playback

Extensive Media Format Support: Decodes HD MPEG1/2/4, H.265, 4K-HD, AVC/VC-1, RM/RMVB, Xvid, DivX, and Real Video formats. Plays various file types including AVI, MKV, MOV, ISO, WMV, FLV, and MPG with subtitle support for SRT, SMI, SUB, SSA, and IDX formats
